But giving away 5 alashi cash loses rank-weight... I'm still rank 0 regardless (40.5-5=35.5 > 29.3). Rank0 50% weight, cash given goes to rival, doesn't change my rank. But wait: also shuttle gives 3 goods to sell next market round 6 — at price ~5-6. 3 goods ≈ 15-18 alashi extra cash, boosting rank 0 payout? My own cash increases my rank but payout is bank shares, not cash itself. Cash only matters for rank. I'm already rank 0 by far. Extra cash doesn't increase payout (except staying rank 0). So bribe 5 is better than produce/shuttle.

Actually shuttle risk 25% seizure, and law 6 may shift price -2. Marginal value near zero. Choose bribe 5 to idx0 or idx1? To idx1 (president, rank2-ish 24.33 vs 24.11). Give to the poorer idx0 keeps rival gap? Giving to idx0 makes 29.1, still rank 1 below me. Either fine; choose idx0.
